caption.body:
Free buyer check list: ten checks before you ship.

A new buyer who sounds perfect still needs checking. This list covers who they are, whether they are real, what others say about them and which payment terms protect you on a first order.

It is a practical checklist, not legal advice. For large orders, use a professional credit report.

leadmagnet.title: Buyer Check List
leadmagnet.subtitle: Ten checks before you ship to a new buyer

sections.heading: Who are they
items: Company registration number and registered address
Website age, email domain and a working phone number
Names of the directors and their profiles
Photos of their office or warehouse if possible

sections.heading: What do others say
items: Ask for two trade references and call them
Search the company name with the word scam
Search the name on trade forums and news
Ask which suppliers they have paid before

sections.heading: Protect yourself
items: Use secure payment terms for a first order
Put price, terms and Incoterms in writing
For large orders, buy a credit report
Ship in parts until trust is built
